kjv.text: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

bsb.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

web.text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

teacher.name: Matthew Henry
teacher.label: Henry treats verse 10 together with verses 10-11

leads.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

flow.say: Henry shows how this verse describes three great meetings of God's graces: in a just government, in a people's return to God, and in Christ's work of salvation.
When rulers and people alike practice mercy, truth, righteousness, and peace together, a land flourishes instead of falling into ruin.
God promises to return mercy to those who return to him in truth and righteousness, and to give them the comfort of peace.

morning.say: Carry into today the truth that Christ brings all these graces together for sinners.
morning.phrase: God may have mercy upon poor sinners, and be at peace with them
